    - separator
    - heading "Introduction" [level=1]
    - 'link "Permalink: Introduction"':
      - /url: "#introduction"
    - paragraph: Camoufox is a Firefox fork engineered for web scraping and AI agents. It is headless, undetectable, and optimized to run at scale. Every run gets a fresh identity drawn from the real-world distribution of devices, so it blends into normal traffic instead of standing out.
    - heading "Highlights" [level=2]
    - 'link "Permalink: Highlights"':
      - /url: "#highlights"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Built for AI agents
        - text: 🤖
        - list:
          - listitem: Minimal, debloated Firefox - fast to launch, cheap to run
          - listitem: Drop-in Playwright compatibility from Python and JavaScript/TypeScript
          - listitem: Invisible to anti-bot systems so you can run your agent cluster locally or in the cloud without being flagged
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Undetectable by design
        - text: 🎭
        - list:
          - listitem:
            - text: Page automation hidden from JavaScript inspection. See the
            - link "stealth page" [e170]:
              - /url: https://camoufox.com/stealth
            - text: for more details.
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Fingerprint injection & rotation (without JS injection!)
        - list:
          - listitem: All navigator properties (device, OS, hardware, browser, etc.) ✅
          - listitem: Screen size, resolution, window, & viewport properties ✅
          - listitem: Geolocation, timezone, locale, & Intl spoofing ✅
          - listitem: WebRTC IP spoofing at the protocol level ✅
          - listitem: Voices, speech playback rate, etc. ✅
          - listitem: And much, much more!
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Anti Graphical fingerprinting
        - list:
          - listitem: WebGL parameters, supported extensions, context attributes, & shader precision formats ✅
          - listitem: Font spoofing & anti-fingerprinting ✅
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - strong: Optimized for automation
        - list:
          - listitem: Human-like mouse movement 🖱️
          - listitem: Blocks & circumvents ads 🛡️
          - listitem:
            - text: Optional instant animations (
            - code: instantAnimations
            - text: ), so Playwright never waits on one 💨
    - list:
      - listitem: Debloated & optimized for memory efficiency ⚡
      - listitem:
        - link "PyPI" [e171]:
          - /url: https://pypi.org/project/camoufox/
        - text: and npm packages for updates & auto fingerprint injection 📦
      - listitem: Stays up to date with the latest Firefox version 🕓
    - separator
    - heading "Fingerprint Injection" [level=2]
    - 'link "Permalink: Fingerprint Injection"':
      - /url: "#fingerprint-injection"
    - paragraph: In Camoufox, data is intercepted at the C++ implementation level, making the changes undetectable through JavaScript inspection.
    - paragraph:
      - text: To spoof individual fingerprint properties, pass a JSON containing properties to spoof to the
      - link "Python" [e172]:
        - /url: /daijro/camoufox/blob/main/pythonlib
      - text: or
      - link "TypeScript" [e173]:
        - /url: /daijro/camoufox/blob/main/typescript
      - text: "interface:"
    - text: ">>> with Camoufox(config={\"property\": \"value\"}) as browser:"
    - button "Copy code to clipboard" [e174]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Config data not set by the user is populated from
      - link "fpgen" [e175]:
        - /url: https://github.com/scrapfly/fingerprint-generator
      - text: ", a model of the statistical distribution of device characteristics in real-world traffic. The assembled identity is then checked for coherence, so parts that are each plausible cannot combine into a machine that does not exist."
    - paragraph:
      - text: "["
      - link "See implemented properties" [e176]:
        - /url: https://camoufox.com/fingerprint/
      - text: "]"
    - separator
    - heading "Usage" [level=2]
    - 'link "Permalink: Usage"':
      - /url: "#usage"
    - paragraph: Camoufox is compatible with your existing Playwright code. You only have to change your browser initialization.
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Python, sync API
    - text: "from camoufox.sync_api import Camoufox with Camoufox() as browser: page = browser.new_page() page.goto(\"https://example.com\")"
    - button "Copy code to clipboard" [e177]
    - paragraph:
      - strong: Python, async API
    - text: "from camoufox.async_api import AsyncCamoufox async with AsyncCamoufox() as browser: page = await browser.new_page() await page.goto(\"https://example.com\")"
    - button "Copy code to clipboard" [e178]
    - paragraph:
      - strong: JavaScript / TypeScript
    - text: "import { Camoufox } from \"camoufox\"; const browser = await Camoufox({ headless: true }); const page = await browser.newPage(); await page.goto(\"https://example.com\"); await browser.close();"
    - button "Copy code to clipboard" [e179]
    - paragraph:

    - heading "Capabilities" [level=2]
    - 'link "Permalink: Capabilities"':
      - /url: "#capabilities"
    - paragraph: Below is a list of patches and features implemented in Camoufox.
    - heading "Fingerprint spoofing" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Fingerprint spoofing"':
      - /url: "#fingerprint-spoofing"
    - list:
      - listitem: Navigator properties spoofing (device, browser, locale, etc.)
      - listitem: Support for emulating screen size, resolution, etc.
      - listitem: Spoof WebGL parameters, supported extensions, context attributes, and shader precision formats.
      - listitem: Spoof inner and outer window viewport sizes
      - listitem: Spoof AudioContext sample rate, output latency, and max channel count
      - listitem: Spoof device voices & playback rates
      - listitem: Spoof the amount of microphones, webcams, and speakers available.
      - listitem: Network headers (Accept-Languages and User-Agent) are spoofed to match the navigator properties
      - listitem: WebRTC IP spoofing at the protocol level
      - listitem: Geolocation, timezone, and locale spoofing
      - listitem: etc.
    - heading "Stealth patches" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Stealth patches"':
      - /url: "#stealth-patches"
    - list:
      - listitem: Avoids main world execution leaks. All page agent javascript is sandboxed
      - listitem: Avoids frame execution context leaks
      - listitem:
        - text: Fixes
        - code: navigator.webdriver
        - text: detection
      - listitem:
        - text: Fixes Firefox headless detection via pointer type (
        - link "#26" [e182]:
          - /url: https://github.com/daijro/camoufox/issues/26
        - text: )
      - listitem: Removed potentially leaking anti-zoom/meta viewport handling patches
      - listitem: Uses non-default screen & window sizes
      - listitem: Re-enable fission content isolations
      - listitem: Re-enable PDF.js
      - listitem: Other leaking config properties changed
      - listitem: Human-like cursor movement
    - heading "Anti font fingerprinting" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Anti font fingerprinting"':
      - /url: "#anti-font-fingerprinting"
    - list:
      - listitem: Automatically uses the correct system fonts for your User Agent
      - listitem: Bundled with Windows, Mac, and Linux system fonts
      - listitem: "No glyph-spacing noise: measured text widths are the ones the same font gives on a real machine"
    - heading "Playwright support" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Playwright support"':
      - /url: "#playwright-support"
    - list:
      - listitem: Custom implementation of Playwright for the latest Firefox
      - listitem: Various config patches to evade bot detection
    - heading "Debloat/Optimizations" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Debloat/Optimizations"':
      - /url: "#debloatoptimizations"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: Stripped out/disabled
        - emphasis: many, many
        - text: Mozilla services. Runs faster than the original Mozilla Firefox, and uses less memory (200mb)
      - listitem: Patches from LibreWolf & Ghostery to help remove telemetry & bloat
      - listitem: Debloat config from PeskyFox, LibreWolf, and others
      - listitem: Speed & network optimizations from FastFox
      - listitem:
        - text: Animations run on stock timing;
        - code: "instantAnimations: True"
        - text: finishes them at once, at the cost of being detectable
      - listitem: Minimalistic theming
      - listitem: etc.
    - heading "Addons" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Addons"':
      - /url: "#addons"
    - list:
      - listitem:
        - text: Load Firefox addons without a debug server by passing a list of paths to the
        - code: addons
        - text: property
      - listitem: Added uBlock Origin with custom privacy filters
      - listitem: Addons are not allowed to open tabs
      - listitem: Addons are automatically enabled in Private Browsing mode
      - listitem: Addons are automatically pinned to the toolbar
      - listitem: Fixes DNS leaks with uBO prefetching
    - heading "Python & TypeScript Interfaces" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Python & TypeScript Interfaces"':
      - /url: "#python--typescript-interfaces"
    - list:
      - listitem: Automatically generates & injects unique device characteristics into Camoufox based on their real-world distribution
      - listitem: WebGL fingerprint injection & rotation
      - listitem: Uses the correct system fonts and subpixel antialiasing & hinting based on your target OS
      - listitem: Avoid proxy detection by calculating your target geolocation, timezone, & locale from your proxy's target region
      - listitem: Calculate and spoof the browser's language based on the distribution of language speakers in the proxy's target region
      - listitem: Remote server hosting to use Camoufox with other languages that support Playwright
      - listitem: Built-in virtual display buffer to run Camoufox headfully on a headless server
      - listitem: Toggle image loading, WebRTC, and WebGL
      - listitem: etc.
    - paragraph: Note
    - paragraph:
      - text: Camoufox does
      - strong: not
      - text: fully support injecting Chromium fingerprints. Some WAFs (such as
      - link "Interstitial" [e183]:
        - /url: https://nopecha.com/demo/cloudflare
      - text: ) test for Spidermonkey engine behavior, which is impossible to spoof.
    - separator
    - heading "Stealth Overview" [level=1]
    - 'link "Permalink: Stealth Overview"':
      - /url: "#stealth-overview"
    - heading "How Camoufox hides its automation library" [level=2]
    - 'link "Permalink: How Camoufox hides its automation library"':
      - /url: "#how-camoufox-hides-its-automation-library"
    - paragraph: In Camoufox, all of Playwright's internal Page Agent's code is sandboxed and isolated. This makes it impossible for a page to detect the presence of Playwright through Javascript inspection.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Normally, Playwright injects some JavaScript into the page such as
      - code: window.__playwright__binding__
      - text: and to perform actions like querying elements, evaluating javascript, or running init scripts, which can be detected by websites. In Camoufox, these actions are handled in an isolated scope outside of the page. In other words, websites can no longer "see" any JavaScript that Playwright would typically inject. This prevents traces of Playwright altogether.
    - paragraph: However, even with hiding its automation library, Camoufox is not immune to inconsistencies in fingerprint rotation. This still requires maintenance to spot and fix.
    - heading "Page Interactions" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Page Interactions"':
      - /url: "#page-interactions"
    - paragraph: Anti-bot systems also run client-side scripts to monitor your behavior. For example, they look for patterns in mouse movements, clicks, scrolling, and the timing between actions.
    - paragraph:
      - link "Cursor paths Camoufox produced with humanize=True, replayed at their recorded speed" [e184]:
        - /url: /daijro/camoufox/blob/main/assets/humanize-cursor.svg
        - img "Cursor paths Camoufox produced with humanize=True, replayed at their recorded speed"
    - paragraph:
      - text: Every dot above is a
      - code: mousemove
      - text: event the page received from six
      - code: page.mouse.move()
      - text: calls, replayed at the speed it arrived. Close dots mean the hand slowed down.
      - code: scripts/cursor-demo.py
      - text: regenerates the figure from a build.
    - paragraph:
      - text: Camoufox does not draw its cursor paths. With
      - code: humanize=True
      - text: it uses
      - link "Cursory" [e185]:
        - /url: https://github.com/Vinyzu/cursory
        - strong: Cursory
      - text: by
      - link "Vinyzu" [e186]:
        - /url: https://github.com/Vinyzu
      - text: ", which holds 2356 mouse movements recorded from real people: it picks a recording whose direction, distance and wander suit the move being made, morphs it onto the requested start and end points, and replays it with that recording's own timing — pauses, overshoots and all."
    - paragraph: "That last part matters as much as the shape. Camoufox previously walked a Bézier curve through two random knots and emitted a point every 10ms. Both halves of that are tells: an analytic curve sampled at a fixed rate has velocity and jerk profiles that separate cleanly from a hand's, and the acceleration came entirely from one easing function, so every movement Camoufox ever made sped up and slowed down the same way. A replayed recording has neither property."
    - paragraph:
      - text: Camoufox ships
      - link "cursory-js" [e187]:
        - /url: https://github.com/JWriter20/cursory-js
      - text: ", a TypeScript port of Cursory, vendored into Juggler at"
      - code: additions/juggler/input/cursory/
      - text: . It reproduces the Python original bit for bit, so a path can be reproduced against
      - code: pip install cursory
      - text: .
      - strong: Cursory is LGPLv3-or-later, not MPL-2.0 like the rest of the browser
      - text: ; its licence and full provenance are in
      - code: additions/juggler/input/cursory/NOTICE
      - text: .
    - paragraph: However, this isn't perfect. It may still be detected with sophisticated enough analysis. (WIP for the future)
    - separator
    - heading "How Camoufox rotates identities" [level=2]
    - 'link "Permalink: How Camoufox rotates identities"':
      - /url: "#how-camoufox-rotates-identities"
    - paragraph:
      - text: AI agents need to operate across many sessions without getting flagged or rate-limited. Rotating your IP address isn't enough — every browser session carries thousands of signals that create a unique
      - strong: fingerprint
      - text: . A website can see your OS, GPU, screen resolution, fonts, timezone, and more. If those signals are inconsistent or unusual, you get blocked.
    - heading "Market Share Distribution" [level=3]
    - 'link "Permalink: Market Share Distribution"':
      - /url: "#market-share-distribution"
    - paragraph: Even if you are rotating your IP for each running bot instance, web access firewalls can still use mach
